capability_coverage.name: Goals and objectives

capability_coverage.planned_behavior: Critical-path/resource/value-aware scheduling and richer bounded replanning

preservation_pillars.name: 1. Personal omnipresence
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: One persistent local AI, global summon hotkey, tray/menu-bar, quiet hours, opt-in screen context, push-to-talk, streaming voice, phone approvals, app extensions

preservation_pillars.name: 2. Global task/goal intelligence
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Versioned goal contracts, task DAGs, priority queues, deadlines, proactive proposals, supervisor intervention, value-of-information scheduling, dependent/parallel agents

preservation_pillars.name: 3. Durable execution
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Crash/reboot and weeks-long wait recovery, leases/fencing, heartbeat, idempotency, outbox, reconciliation, human wait, priority & backpressure, multi-machine worker queues

preservation_pillars.name: 4. Two-broker provider abstraction
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Native vendor harnesses and local/cloud raw inference as separate interfaces; ACP/MCP/A2A interop; explicit capabilities rather than pretending subscriptions are API keys

preservation_pillars.name: 5. Intelligent routing and accounting
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Entitlement state, rate limits, reset forecasting, quota opportunity cost, API daily pacing, plan reserve, task-class success estimates, budget hard stop, provider terms

preservation_pillars.name: 6. Local inference serving
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Dynamic model selection, quantization, CPU/GPU offload, GPU affinity, batching, shared-prefix caching, precision/capability testing, active/cold models

preservation_pillars.name: 7. Resource-aware good-neighbor OS
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: CPU/RAM/VRAM/resource limits, AC/battery, thermals, idle/foreground mode, model eviction/swap, tenant/process isolation, fair scheduling

preservation_pillars.name: 8. Privacy/security governance
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Independent trust/privacy/autonomy; local-only Restricted; inherited labels; least privilege, sandbox, OPA authorization, prompt injection defense, secrets, audited egress and action approval

preservation_pillars.name: 9. Memory as portable asset
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Profile/standing rules, project decisions, factual provenance, episodic memory, reusable skills, RAG documents, metadata, cross-tool context packs, conflict/supersession

preservation_pillars.name: 10. Memory lifecycle and forgetting
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Hot/warm/cold/tombstones, value scoring, provenance-aware merging, decays/half-lives, source lineage, user pins, GDPR-like erasure & cryptographic backup policy, eval-based compaction

preservation_pillars.name: 11. Tool/capability discovery
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Semantic + typed capability registry, MCP Registry scouting, install proposals with permission manifests, signature/pin/scan, empirical quality scores, only task-needed tool descriptors loaded

preservation_pillars.name: 12. Specialist packs
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Load-on-demand coding, browser, vision, image generation, speech transcription, speech synthesis, RE, science/other custom tasks with hardware-adaptive model manifests

preservation_pillars.name: 13. Human/computer collaboration
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Desktop/window selected context, clipboard capture, browser automation, site permissions, pre-action previews, reusable IDE integrations and human review inbox

preservation_pillars.name: 14. Mission Control and observability
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: Live fleet, task graph, priorities, quota reset curves, spend by task/provider, logs/traces, risk, skills, memory, test/eval quality, cloud exposure; UI + TUI/API

preservation_pillars.name: 15. Continuous measured improvement
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: User corrections, memory/routing attribution, frozen + live eval sets, prompt optimizer, skill mining, controlled LoRA/QLoRA of local steward, canary and rollback

preservation_pillars.name: 16. Portability and open source
preservation_pillars.baseline_target_text: One kernel on CPU-only laptops/Ubuntu NVIDIA/Mac Studio, BYO subscriptions, provider compliance, Apache-2.0 candidate, installer profiles, signed builds, SBOM, offline-first operation
